game.name: N3 : Ninety-Nine Nights (Japan)(Demo)
game.desc: N3: Ninety-Nine Nights on Xbox 360 is an action game in which your hero (or heroine, as the case may be) is confronted with a mass of enemies that you have to send flying in packs of 12 or more. Seven characters are available, each with their own characteristics. It's up to you to jump into the fray to discover the history of the protagonists and unlock some bonuses such as artworks.
